employee_id: Unique employee identifier — not used for model training (surrogate row key)
age: Employee age in years (float, ~15% missing values)
years_experience: Total years of professional work experience
annual_income: Annual income in USD (float, ~10% missing values; lognormal distribution)
department: Department the employee belongs to (Sales, Engineering, Marketing, HR)
random_noise: Random noise column — uniform [0,1], no predictive value
useless_feature: Sparse feature with ~90% missing values — very low information content
high_performer: Target variable: 1 = high performer (above-median income AND >10 years experience), 0 = otherwise
